items.body: In Solomonic grimoires, nothing begins until the circle is drawn and the name is spoken. The ritual is not superstition — it is priority made visible. You do not summon until the gate is sealed. Diligence is the same art in daylight: name the binding obligation, close it, then open the lesser spirits of the inbox.

Gnostic teachers distinguished knowing-about from knowing-through. Catalogs of aeons and archons were maps, not the territory. The spark they pointed to was recognition under pressure — the moment attention stops performing and simply sees. A morning paper can feed facts; only practice turns them into sight.

Hermetic correspondence teaches that outer order mirrors inner sequence. Pay the policy, then the phone, then the note — not because the cosmos invoices you, but because scattered will fragments the day. Align the ledger and the breath; the rest of the week follows the pattern you set on Monday.

items.hed: Siri AI ships English beta with iOS 27 on Sept. 14
items.body: Apple’s overhauled Siri lands today in English alongside iOS 27, with additional languages expected in October. Reporting ties Gemini to parts of the training stack; EU iPhone availability remains delayed while regulatory review continues. Server-side Apple Intelligence still carries daily usage caps.

items.hed: Agents API public beta Sept. 10; GPT-Live-1 joins the roster
items.body: OpenAI opened its Agents API to public beta on Sept. 10 and added GPT-Live-1 for full-duplex voice in the API. The company continues to navigate agent-safety fallout while leadership echoes calls to slow a reckless frontier pace.

items.hed: Grok 4.7 delayed on RL length penalty; Grok Bot enterprise live
items.body: xAI slipped Grok 4.7 past its roughly Sept. 12 target. Elon Musk cited an RL length penalty that encouraged early quit and weak self-check; Grok 4.6 remains current. Grok Bot for Enterprise launched in early September.

items.hed: Fable / Mythos 5.1; Amodei urges slowing the frontier
items.body: Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 cut agentic costs via cheaper cache reads. Dario Amodei’s essay calls for restraint at the frontier; the company also published threat intel on Claude misuse campaigns.

items.hed: Kawhi Clippers→Raptors trade still in limbo
items.body: The Kawhi Leonard move from the Clippers to the Raptors remains unfinalized. Los Angeles is still sorting acting governance and basketball-ops leadership after suspensions.
Federal prosecutors are investigating the Clippers’ dealings involving Kawhi Leonard, per mid-September reporting from The New York Times and Reuters.
Camps open around Sept. 22. The trade is expected to clear before tip-off of camp; Leonard has already joined Raptors player activities while paperwork catches up.

items.body: Seattle beat New England 13–10 in Week 1. Patriots quarterback Sam Darnold left early with a hip injury.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Insurance first. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not chase the week — he sequences it. Fierce calm is not soft; it is competitive composure under a real clock: reinstate by the 21st, ride the Sept. 16 paycheck, stack the 23rd, land Vegas covered. One gate, one confirmation, one transfer at a time. Competitors may arrive loud; he arrives prepared and solvent. When pressure rises, he slows the breath, names the next dollar move, and outlasts the noise. Today is not about proving anything. It is about executing the money week so cleanly that Vegas is just travel.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Then Direct Auto portal.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips if you want a second RipStick move.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.hed: First Things Bound, Then the Field
grimoire.body: “Go to the ant, O sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise. Without having any chief, officer, or ruler, she prepares her bread in summer and gathers her food in harvest.” (Proverbs 6:6–8) Solomon’s ant is not a hustle meme — it is ordered foresight. The colony does not debate every crumb; it stores against the season that will not wait. Your season is written on the calendar: Sept. 21 reinstate, Sept. 25 Vegas. Classical lore cast Solomon as a binder who named spirits before they spoke; you bind Monday the same way — name the insurance gate, confirm the sum, schedule the payment — then let lesser errands approach. Diligence is practical magick: sequence is the seal.
grimoire.practice: Before any other tab: open Direct Auto, write the exact amount, put Sept. 21 on the calendar. That is the seal.
